notable_absence.finding: This page enumerates roughly 60 built-in token filters (apostrophe, camelCase, elision_*, stemmer_*, stop_*, to_lower, unique, etc.) but states no default token filter set for a new analyzer - unlike default_analyzer and default_datetime_parser, which search-index-params.md gives explicit default values for.
